title_zh: 首款触屏 MacBook Pro 今日发售，M6 款同步开卖
content_zh:
苹果将于 11 月 6 日在中国大陆正式发售两条新款 MacBook Pro 产品线。采用 PROLED XDR 显示屏的机型提供 14 英寸和 16 英寸版本，搭载 M5 Pro 或 M5 Max 芯片。

触屏款采用双层串联 OLED 面板，支持滚动、双指开合和旋转等多点触控手势。苹果也在这条产品线上引入了灵动岛，并重新设计了散热系统。

同一天发售的另一款 14 英寸 MacBook Pro 搭载 M6 芯片，配备 12 核 CPU 和 12 核 GPU，沿用 Liquid 视网膜 XDR 显示屏。

🔗 相关阅读：MacBook Pro 能触屏了，但这只是它最小的升级｜附选购指南
title_en: Apple Launches First Touchscreen MacBook Pro Alongside New M6 Model
content_en:
Apple has officially launched its latest MacBook Pro lineup in mainland China, introducing its first-ever touchscreen laptop alongside an updated base model. The premium 14-inch and 16-inch variants boast PROLED XDR displays and are powered by the new M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.

The flagship touchscreen version features a tandem OLED panel supporting multi-touch gestures such as scrolling, pinching, and rotating. Apple has also brought the Dynamic Island to the Mac for the first time and redesigned the internal thermal architecture to accommodate these upgrades.

Alongside the touchscreen devices, Apple also released an entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro powered by the next-generation M6 chip, featuring a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU while retaining the Liquid Retina XDR display.

title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Cyber，首批开放给获批的安全团队
content_zh:
OpenAI 发布网络安全模型 GPT-6 Cyber，首批通过 API 和 Codex 向部分获批的 Daybreak Red 客户开放。OpenAI 将它在网络安全方面的能力评为最高的「关键」级，上代 GPT-5.6 Cyber 的评级为「高」。

在 OpenAI 的 Linux 内核研究中，GPT-6 Cyber 复现了 1724 项漏洞，为其中 948 项开发出可运行的本地提权利用方式。研究团队按 Linux 社区指引向维护者披露了其中 304 项关键发现，并提供候选补丁。

模型也在 Firefox 中找到了 81 项此前未知的高危漏洞，并协助拟定补丁。OpenAI 称，Mozilla 已修复其中多项漏洞。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，GPT-6 Cyber 正式发布，AI 最强的矛也成了最强的盾
title_en: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6 Cyber with 'Critical' Capability Rating
content_en:
OpenAI has officially launched GPT-6 Cyber, a specialized cybersecurity model currently accessible via API and Codex to select approved Daybreak Red security clients. OpenAI has elevated the model's cybersecurity capability rating to "Critical," up from the "High" rating given to its predecessor, GPT-5.6 Cyber.

In vulnerability research involving the Linux kernel, GPT-6 Cyber successfully reproduced 1,724 vulnerabilities and developed functional local privilege escalation exploits for 948 of them. Following community guidelines, the research team disclosed 304 critical findings to Linux maintainers alongside candidate patches.

Additionally, the model discovered 81 previously unknown high-severity vulnerabilities in Mozilla Firefox and helped draft corresponding fixes, several of which have already been patched by Mozilla.

title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 单日活跃用户达 154 万，团队拟建官方插件市场
content_zh:
DeepSeek Harness 团队 11 月 5 日公布了桌面端上线后的使用数据。以使用官方 API 的用户为统计范围，11 月 4 日单日活跃用户达到 154 万，日消耗约 92 万亿个 Token。

团队称，第三方插件已增至约 3.5 万个，约六成活跃用户制作或安装过至少一款。Harness 的内置功能也可以被第三方插件替换。团队计划建设官方插件市场，改进插件接口的稳定性和兼容性，并完善安全机制。

面向插件作者的支持计划正在征集意向，团队提出的支持方式包括 Token 激励、技术交流和作品推荐。
title_en: DeepSeek Harness Hits 1.54M DAU, Plans Official Plugin Store
content_en:
The DeepSeek Harness team released usage metrics following the debut of its desktop client, reporting 1.54 million daily active users (DAU) leveraging official APIs on November 4. Total daily token consumption reached an unprecedented 92 trillion tokens.

The platform's plugin ecosystem is expanding rapidly, now hosting roughly 35,000 third-party plugins, with nearly 60% of active users installing or creating at least one. In response, the team plans to establish an official plugin marketplace while upgrading API stability, compatibility, and security measures.

To further empower developers, the team is gathering interest for a creator support program, offering token incentives, technical collaboration, and featured promotions for top plugin authors.

title_zh: 丰田将设立直属机器人部门，由首席生产官兼任负责人
content_zh:
丰田汽车 11 月 5 日宣布，将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日设立直属公司管理的 Toyota Robotics，由执行役员兼首席生产官志贺武文兼任负责人。

丰田将把分散在公司内部的机器人技术、人员和职能集中到新部门，并把机器人列为未来业务的关键支柱之一。新部门将与开发团队合作，从制造一线的实际需求出发，推动机器人的应用、商业化和部署。

同一轮调整还将撤销碳中和工程开发中心，把相关人才与职能并入动力总成公司，重点转向混合动力系统的规划和开发。
title_en: Toyota to Launch Dedicated Robotics Division Led by Chief Production Officer
content_en:
Toyota Motor announced on November 5 that it will establish a dedicated corporate unit, "Toyota Robotics," on January 1, 2027. The division will be headed by Takefumi Shiga, Executive Officer and Chief Production Officer.

By consolidating internal robotics technologies, talent, and operations, Toyota aims to make robotics a vital pillar for its future growth. The new division will collaborate closely with R&D teams to accelerate the deployment and commercialization of robotics tailored to real-world manufacturing needs.

As part of the same organizational restructuring, Toyota will dissolve its Carbon Neutral Engineering Development Center, merging its workforce into the Powertrain Company to focus heavily on hybrid system planning and development.

title_zh: Claude Code 前产品负责人加入 OpenAI，掌管核心产品
content_zh:
曾负责 Claude Code 和 Cowork 产品的 Cat Wu 于 11 月 5 日宣布加入 OpenAI，负责核心产品的产品管理。她点名将与 OpenAI 的 Thibault Sottiaux 合作，开发面向个人和团队、由用户保有控制权的智能体。

同日上午，曾参与搭建 Anthropic 增长团队的 Austin Lau 也宣布自己近期已加入 OpenAI。

🔗 相关阅读：突发！Claude Code 「产品一姐」加入OpenAI，前一天刚宣布离职
title_en: Former Anthropic Product Lead Cat Wu Joins OpenAI to Head Core Products
content_en:
Cat Wu, former product lead for Anthropic's Claude Code and Cowork, announced on November 5 that she has joined OpenAI to oversee product management for core products. She plans to collaborate with OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux to build user-controlled AI agents for both individuals and teams.

On the same day, Austin Lau, who previously helped establish Anthropic's growth team, also revealed that he recently joined OpenAI, highlighting a key talent movement between the two AI rivals.

title_zh: 三季度全球 DRAM 营收逼近 2000 亿美元，价格上涨是主因
content_zh:
Counterpoint Research 发布的跟踪报告显示，2026 年第三季度全球 DRAM 营收接近 2000 亿美元，同比增长 369%。同期 DRAM 位元出货量环比仅增约 4%，平均售价升至每 Gb 1.9 美元。Counterpoint 将这轮营收大涨主要归因于价格上升，AI 加速器和数据中心的需求加剧了厂商对货源的争夺。

按营收计算，三星以 38% 的份额居首，SK 海力士营收环比增长逾 40%，缩小了与三星的差距。长鑫存储的营收份额从上季度的 10% 降至 9%。
title_en: Global DRAM Revenue Nears $200 Billion in Q3 Driven by Sharp Price Hikes
content_en:
Global DRAM revenue approached $200 billion in the third quarter of 2026, representing a dramatic 369% year-over-year surge, according to a report by Counterpoint Research. The spike was primarily driven by rising prices—with average selling prices reaching $1.90 per Gb—while bit shipments grew by only about 4% quarter-over-quarter. Counterpoint attributed the price growth to fierce competition for supply fueled by AI accelerators and data center expansion.

Samsung maintained its market lead with a 38% revenue share. SK Hynix closed the gap with Samsung after posting sequential revenue growth of over 40%, while CXMT saw its revenue share slip slightly from 10% to 9%.

title_zh: 全球平板出货创近三年新低，前五厂商仅联想增长
content_zh:
Omdia 公布的数据显示，第三季度全球平板电脑出货量约 3200 万台，同比下降 23%，为近三年来的最低水平。上一季度的跌幅为 10%，中东、中国和西欧市场本季度的跌幅尤其明显。

苹果仍以 36% 的份额居首，但出货量同比下降约 28%。华为同比下降 43%，在前五家厂商中跌幅最大。联想以约 410 万台排在第三，出货同比增长约 12%，是前五家中唯一增长的品牌，增量主要来自普通平板。

Omdia 指出，元器件供应紧张限制了新品的配置升级，部分消费者可能继续推迟换机。
title_en: Global Tablet Shipments Hit Three-Year Low as Lenovo Stands Out as Sole Gainer
content_en:
Global tablet shipments plummeted 23% year-over-year in the third quarter to approximately 32 million units, reaching their lowest point in nearly three years, according to data from market research firm Omdia. The downturn accelerated from a 10% drop in the prior quarter, with contractions particularly pronounced across the Middle East, China, and Western Europe.

Apple retained its market-leading position with a 36% share despite a 28% decline in shipments. Huawei suffered the steepest drop among top vendors, falling 43%. Meanwhile, Lenovo secured third place with roughly 4.1 million units—a 12% year-over-year increase—making it the only top-five manufacturer to post growth, driven largely by demand for its standard tablet lineup.

Omdia highlighted that ongoing component shortages have constrained hardware upgrades in newly released models, leading consumers to further defer replacing their existing devices.

title_zh: 鸿蒙电脑累计发货破百万，华为带来政企台式机与企业版
content_zh:
华为终端公布，截至 10 月 31 日，鸿蒙电脑累计发货量突破 100 万台，已上架的应用超过 2.1 万款。余承东在转发这一数据时同时宣布，面向企业办公的擎云 HM650 系列和鸿蒙电脑企业版亮相。

HM650 系列是华为面向政企市场的鸿蒙台式机。华为终端平板与 PC 产品线总裁朱懂东还在办公产业峰会上预告，另一款鸿蒙电脑新品将于下周开始预热。

峰会上，华为终端 BG CEO 何刚预计，搭载 HarmonyOS 6 或 7 的设备数量将在 11 月下旬突破 1 亿台。华为终端 BG 全球生态发展总裁宁胜蓝介绍，鸿蒙电脑独立应用已超过 2.1 万款，华为和合作伙伴每月培养超过 10 万名鸿蒙开发者。
title_en: Huawei Surpasses 1 Million HarmonyOS PC Shipments, Expands Into Enterprise Sector
content_en:
Huawei Terminal announced that total shipments of HarmonyOS-powered PCs have topped one million units as of October 31, backed by an ecosystem of over 21,000 available applications. Building on this momentum, Huawei Consumer BG Chairman Richard Yu unveiled the Qingyun HM650 desktop series and an enterprise OS edition designed specifically for corporate and government clients.

During a recent industry summit, Zhu Dongdong, President of Huawei's Tablet & PC Product Line, revealed that promotional teasers for another new HarmonyOS PC product will launch next week. Additionally, Huawei Consumer BG CEO He Gang projected that total devices running HarmonyOS 6 or 7 will surpass 100 million by late November.

To sustain ecosystem growth, Huawei and its business partners are currently training more than 100,000 HarmonyOS developers per month, according to Ning Shenglan, President of Global Ecosystem Development at Huawei Terminal BG.

title_zh: 杨元庆给联想 PC 定下长期目标：全球份额 30%
content_zh:
据第一财经报道，联想集团董事长兼 CEO 杨元庆在全球行业分析师大会上表示，联想正朝着全球 PC 市场份额 30% 的长期目标迈进。IDC 数据显示，联想今年第三季度在全球出货 1490 万台 PC，市场份额为 23.8%。

在供应紧张、价格上涨的背景下，杨元庆预计，PC 出货量短期内会面临压力。他表示，单机收入正在提高，可以抵消部分出货下降带来的影响。
title_en: Lenovo CEO Targets 30% Global PC Market Share Despite Supply Pressures
content_en:
Lenovo Group Chairman and CEO Yang Yuanqing stated at a global industry analyst conference that the company is striving toward a long-term goal of securing a 30% share of the global PC market. According to IDC data, Lenovo shipped 14.9 million PCs in the third quarter, maintaining its market leadership with a 23.8% share.

Yang acknowledged that short-term PC shipments will remain under pressure amid tight component supplies and rising costs. However, he emphasized that rising average revenue per unit is helping offset the financial impact of lower shipment volumes.

title_zh: Switch 2 第二财季卖出 267 万台，同比减少约四成
content_zh:
任天堂公布截至 9 月底的半年度业绩。Switch 2 在 4 月至 9 月售出 649 万台，游戏软件卖出 2449 万份。《斯普拉遁：突袭者》在 7 月推出，截至期末销量为 242 万份。同期初代 Switch 仍售出 127 万台，软件销量为 6573 万份。

任天堂上半财年营收为 9660.41 亿日元，同比下降 12.1%，营业利润同比增长 49.1% 至 2165 亿日元。任天堂将营业利润增长归因于软件销售占比提高，以及第一财季收到此前计入销售成本的美国关税退款。公司维持全年业绩预期。

按季度看，Switch 2 第二财季卖出 267 万台，低于上年同期的 454 万台，也少于第一财季的 382 万台。任天堂仍预计本财年 Switch 2 销量为 1650 万台。
title_en: Nintendo Switch 2 Q2 Sales Drop 40% to 2.67 Million Units, Full-Year Target Maintained
content_en:
Nintendo released its half-year financial results through September, revealing that Switch 2 hardware sales fell approximately 40% year-over-year in the second quarter to 2.67 million units. Despite the quarterly slowdown from the 3.82 million units sold in Q1, Nintendo maintained its full-year sales forecast of 16.5 million units for the console.

For the first half of the fiscal year (April to September), total Switch 2 sales reached 6.49 million units alongside 24.49 million software copies, boosted by *Splatoon: Raiders*, which sold 2.42 million units following its July launch. The original Switch also contributed 1.27 million console sales and 65.73 million software sales during the same period.

Nintendo reported H1 revenue of 966.04 billion yen, down 12.1% year-over-year, while operating profit surged 49.1% to 216.5 billion yen. The profit growth was largely driven by a higher proportion of digital software sales and a U.S. tariff refund received in the first quarter.

title_zh: 混元 Hy4 上线首日调用激增，腾讯称扩容十倍
content_zh:
腾讯混元表示，Hy4 于 11 月 4 日在 WorkBuddy 首发接入，上线首日就有大量用户触及使用额度。团队已将 Hy4 推理集群紧急扩容十倍，并提高了用户的免费体验额度。

腾讯称，高峰时段仍可能有个别用户触及限额，建议遇到限额时切换到 Hy3 等模型，也可以把非紧急任务放到晚间。WorkBuddy 上的 Hy3 限免延长至 11 月 15 日 23:59。
title_en: Tencent Expands Hunyuan Hy4 Capacity 10-Fold Following Launch Day Surge
content_en:
Tencent's newly launched Hunyuan Hy4 AI model experienced a massive surge in demand on its first day of availability on WorkBuddy on November 4, causing many users to hit usage limits.

In response, Tencent's engineering team urgently expanded the Hy4 inference compute cluster ten-fold and increased free usage quotas. While peak-hour limits may still occur, Tencent recommends switching to models like Hy3 during high-traffic periods or scheduling non-urgent tasks for off-peak hours. Additionally, free access to Hy3 on WorkBuddy has been extended through November 15.

title_zh: Arm 第二财季营收创同期新高，数据中心版税翻倍
content_zh:
Arm 公布截至 9 月 30 日的 2027 财年第二季度业绩。公司当季营收 14.43 亿美元，同比增长 27%，创第二财季纪录。按 GAAP 计算，净利润 1.3 亿美元，同比下降 45%。

授权及其他收入增长 50% 至 7.73 亿美元，Arm 将增长归因于知识产权需求和多份大额授权合同的确认节奏。特许权使用费收入增长 8% 至 6.7 亿美元，其中数据中心特许权使用费同比翻倍。Arm 称，数据中心部署增加和费率更高的 Armv9 等技术普及带来增长，智能手机市场受到内存涨价冲击，抵消了部分增量。
title_en: Arm Reports Record Q2 Revenue Driven by Doubling Datacenter Royalties
content_en:
Arm announced record second-quarter revenue of $1.443 billion for the period ending September 30, representing a 27% year-over-year increase. However, GAAP net profit fell 45% year-over-year to $130 million.

Growth was led by licensing and other revenues, which jumped 50% to $773 million due to robust IP demand and favorable timing for major contract recognitions. Royalty revenue rose 8% to $670 million, highlighted by a 100% year-over-year surge in datacenter royalties.

The company attributed its strong royalty performance to expanding datacenter deployments and the wider adoption of higher-margin Armv9 architecture, which helped offset headwinds in the smartphone market caused by rising memory prices.

title_zh: 高通手机芯片季度收入下滑 26%，汽车芯片收入增长 89%
content_zh:
高通公布截至 9 月 27 日的 2026 财年第四季度业绩。按 GAAP 计算，营收 103.22 亿美元，同比下滑 8%。手机芯片收入降至 51.37 亿美元，降幅为 26%，仍是芯片业务中收入最高的一项。

汽车芯片收入同比增长 89% 至 19.9 亿美元，物联网芯片收入同比增长 4% 至 18.88 亿美元。高通称，晶圆制造、封装测试及存储器等环节成本普遍上升，公司已调整产品价格，预计其影响将在 2027 财年下半年充分反映在芯片业务的毛利率中。
title_en: Qualcomm Q4 Revenue Drops 8% as Automotive Growth Fails to Offset Mobile Decline
content_en:
Qualcomm reported an 8% year-over-year decline in GAAP revenue to $10.32 billion for its fourth fiscal quarter ending September 27. The slump was primarily driven by a 26% drop in handset chip revenue, which fell to $5.14 billion but remains the company’s largest revenue source.

In contrast, Qualcomm's automotive segment posted strong momentum, with revenue surging 89% year-over-year to $1.99 billion. IoT chip revenue also saw a modest increase of 4%, reaching $1.89 billion.

To counter rising costs across wafer fabrication, packaging, testing, and memory, the chipmaker has adjusted its product pricing. The full impact of these price adjustments on gross margins is expected to materialize in the second half of fiscal 2027.

title_zh: 国产视频模型公司 Sand.ai 完成 2 亿美元融资
content_zh:
Sand.ai 于 11 月 5 日宣布完成 2 亿美元 A+ 轮融资，由基石资本与网宿科技联合领投。公司称，这是其今年第三轮融资，10 个月累计融资 3 亿美元。

Sand.ai 此前已开放视频模型 MAGI-2 的预览版权重。据《证券时报》报道，公司计划在接下来几周发布采用混合专家架构的 MAGI-2 正式版。网宿科技曾在 9 月向深交所披露拟参与本轮融资，公告列出的标的业务包括视频生成模型研发和音乐视频工具 VidMuse。
title_en: Chinese AI Video Startup Sand.ai Secures $200M Series A+ Funding
content_en:
Chinese AI video startup Sand.ai announced on November 5 that it has raised $200 million in a Series A+ funding round, co-led by Cornerstone Capital and Wangsu Science & Technology. This marks the company's third fundraising round this year, bringing its total capital raised over the past 10 months to $300 million.

The capital injection will support Sand.ai’s product development, including the upcoming official release of its video generation model, MAGI-2, which utilizes a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture.

In addition to AI video generation models, Sand.ai's portfolio includes VidMuse, a specialized tool designed for creating AI-generated music videos.

title_zh: 游戏与影视带动索尼营业利润增长 45%，全年指引上调
content_zh:
索尼公布截至 9 月底的第二财季业绩。持续经营业务营收为 34294 亿日元，同比增长约 10%，营业利润为 6223 亿日元，同比增长约 45%。

游戏及网络服务是营业利润增量的最大来源。索尼称，网络服务和第一方游戏销售增加，同时上年同期曾计入 Bungie 相关资产减值及开发成本调整，本季度少了这两项拖累。影视业务方面，新一部《蜘蛛侠》是院线收入增长的主要来源。

索尼把本财年营业利润预期从 1.72 万亿日元上调至 1.87 万亿日元。
title_en: Sony Q2 Operating Profit Jumps 45% on Gaming and Movie Surge; Full-Year Outlook Raised
content_en:
Sony reported strong financial results for its second fiscal quarter ending September, driven by robust momentum in its gaming and entertainment divisions. Revenue from continuing operations rose 10% year-over-year to 3.43 trillion yen, while operating profit surged 45% to 622.3 billion yen.

The Gaming & Network Services segment was the main catalyst for profit growth, propelled by strong network service revenues, robust first-party game sales, and the absence of last year's Bungie-related impairment charges. Meanwhile, theatrical earnings in the Pictures division were anchored by the latest *Spider-Man* release.

Encouraged by the strong quarter, Sony has raised its full-year operating profit forecast from 1.72 trillion yen to 1.87 trillion yen.

title_zh: 💡 星尘智能创始人来杰：能进入家庭的机器人可能在明年出现
content_zh:
星尘智能创始人兼 CEO 来杰在接受爱范儿专访时，用一个杯子解释了团队为什么选择绳驱结构。机器人把杯子放到桌上时，如果能感知桌面已经承托住杯子，就可以据此松手。来杰希望机器人学到的是物体接触时的受力变化。

在他看来，用绳索把动力传到关节，可以让机器人更清楚地感知外力，也能把电机从手腕等部位移开。他还把具身模型和基础大模型分在两个层次：前者处理感知和动作，后者规划任务，操作系统负责把两者接起来。

来杰用视频学做饭比喻这种分工：电话另一端的人可以告诉你先往热锅里放油，拿起油瓶和控制倒油仍要由自己完成。他认为，让基础大模型接收全部触觉数据，会带来带宽和成本问题。机器人可以先判断瓶子有没有抓稳，需要时再向大模型询问下一步。

来杰认为，当前的机器人离他所说的「iPhone 4 时刻」还有距离。他预计，能进入家庭的机器人可能在明年出现。

🔗 相关阅读：对话星尘智能来杰：机器人的「iPhone 4 时刻」还没到，但可能比想象中更近丨多样性公司
title_en: Home Robots Could Arrive as Soon as Next Year, Says Astribot Founder
content_en:
Lai Jie, founder and CEO of Astribot, shared insights in a recent interview regarding the future of robotics and why his team adopted a cable-driven architecture. By transmitting power through cables rather than heavy motors placed directly at the joints, robots can better sense subtle external force changes and achieve delicate physical interactions, such as placing a cup softly onto a table.

Lai outlined a two-tier system architecture for intelligent robots: embodied AI models handle real-time perception and physical actions, while foundational large language models (LLMs) plan broader task logic. A custom operating system bridges the two. He noted that feeding raw tactile data directly to LLMs causes bandwidth and cost issues, so robots should process physical feedback locally before querying LLMs for subsequent steps.

While Lai believes the robotics industry has not yet reached its defining "iPhone 4 moment," he predicts that household-capable robots could make their commercial debut as early as next year.

title_zh: 纯电双座 smart 精灵 #2 豪华版上市，限时权益价 9.99 万元
content_zh:
smart 精灵 #2 Premium 豪华版于 11 月 5 日在国内上市，限时权益价 9.99 万元。这款纯电双座小车延续了 fortwo 的短车身和双色设计，车长不到 2.8 米，最小转弯半径为 3.35 米。

新车基于 smart 的 ECA 纯电平台，采用后置后驱布局。豪华版搭载最大功率 60kW 的电机和 35.8kWh 磷酸铁锂电池，CLTC 续航为 410 公里。车尾保留上下分体式尾门，车内有 8.8 英寸仪表屏和 12.8 英寸中控屏，中控屏下方留了一排实体按键。
title_en: Two-Seater Electric smart #2 Premium Launches in China at Limited-Time 99,900 Yuan
content_en:
The all-electric two-seater smart #2 Premium Edition officially launched in China on November 5 with a limited-time promotional price of 99,900 RMB. Maintaining the iconic compact, two-tone aesthetic of the classic fortwo, the vehicle measures under 2.8 meters in length with an exceptionally nimble turning radius of just 3.35 meters.

Built on smart's ECA electric architecture with a rear-motor, rear-wheel-drive layout, the car is equipped with a 60kW electric motor and a 35.8 kWh LFP battery, delivering a CLTC range of 410 kilometers.

Practical features include a signature split tailgate and an upgraded interior featuring an 8.8-inch digital cluster, a 12.8-inch central touchscreen, and a row of physical shortcut buttons for essential controls.

title_zh: 月之暗面开放 Kimi K3.1 Pro 权重
content_zh: 月之暗面在 Hugging Face 放出 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的完整模型权重。这个 10 月已通过 API 上线的模型采用混合专家架构，总参数 2.8 万亿，支持图像输入和 100 万 Token 上下文。其专用许可证允许商业使用，并要求分发时保留版权和许可声明。
title_en: Moonshot AI Open-Sources Kimi K3.1 Pro Weights on Hugging Face
content_en:
Moonshot AI has released the complete open model weights for Kimi K3.1 Pro on Hugging Face. First made available via API in October, the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model boasts a total of 2.8 trillion parameters, multi-modal image input support, and a massive 1-million-token context window.

The released model operates under a custom license that permits commercial usage, provided that original copyright and license notices are preserved upon redistribution.

title_zh: 百度开放文心 5.5 Flash Base 权重，推理支持百万 Token 上下文
content_zh:
百度于 11 月 5 日开放文心 5.5 Flash Base 的基座模型权重，在 Hugging Face 和魔搭提供 FP8 与 BF16 两个版本。

该模型采用混合专家架构，总参数量为 2800 亿，每处理一个 Token 激活其中 140 亿参数。模型从头预训练使用了 33.5 万亿个 Token，预训练上下文最长为 128K，微调与推理支持最长 100 万 Token。百度也在模型卡中给出了 SGLang 和 vLLM 的部署步骤。
title_en: Baidu Open-Sources ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base Weights with 1M-Token Context Support
content_en:
Baidu has officially released the base model weights for ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base on Hugging Face and ModelScope, offering both FP8 and BF16 precision formats.

Built on a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, the model boasts 280 billion total parameters, with 14 billion activated per token. It was pre-trained from scratch on 33.5 trillion tokens, featuring a 128K pre-training context window and supporting up to 1 million tokens for fine-tuning and inference. Baidu has also included deployment instructions for popular inference engines like SGLang and vLLM.

title_zh: Kimi 开放智能体云托管，企业可配置沙箱与联网权限
content_zh:
月之暗面发布 Kimi Hosted Agents，将智能体运行所需的代码执行、会话管理和工具调用等能力封装成云服务。企业可用它在内部部署运维助手，也可将客服、投研等智能体接入自己的产品。

开发者可在 Kimi API 开放平台的控制台试用，也能使用 API 或命令行接入。任务在独立沙箱中运行，企业可配置网络访问权限、随时中止会话，并导出执行记录供审计。
title_en: Moonshot AI Launches Kimi Hosted Agents with Enterprise Sandbox Controls
content_en:
Moonshot AI has introduced Kimi Hosted Agents, a cloud service that packages essential agent capabilities—such as code execution, session management, and tool calling—into a fully managed platform. The service allows enterprises to build internal IT maintenance assistants or integrate specialized customer service and research agents directly into their products.

Developers can access the feature through the Kimi API platform console, API, or command-line interface. All tasks run inside isolated sandboxes, allowing organizations to manage network access permissions, terminate active sessions on demand, and export detailed execution logs for security auditing.

title_zh: Claude 测试个人账本，可连接银行和信用卡查询开支
content_zh:
Anthropic 在 Claude 中推出个人财务功能。美国的 Pro、Max 和 Ultra 订阅者本周起陆续获得测试资格，可以通过 Plaid 连接银行和信用卡账户，查询余额、交易及账单。

Claude 可以汇总不同账户的支出，按类别列出花销，也可以生成账单日历或每周支出图表。用户可以继续追问一笔费用来自哪里，或对照以往月份查看是否出现重复扣款和涨价。

账户授权为只读，Claude 最多可读取已连接账户两年的交易记录。Anthropic 表示，个人财务页面内的对话不会用于训练模型。
title_en: Anthropic Tests Personal Finance Features in Claude via Plaid Integration
content_en:
Anthropic is rolling out a new personal finance feature for Claude, available in beta to Pro, Max, and Ultra subscribers in the U.S. Powered by Plaid, the integration enables users to securely link their bank and credit card accounts to track balances, transactions, and bills directly within the interface.

Claude can aggregate spending across multiple accounts, categorize expenses, and generate visual summaries like bill calendars or weekly spending charts. Users can also inquire about specific charges or compare historical data to identify duplicate billings and price increases.

To safeguard user privacy, account access is strictly read-only, covering up to two years of historical transaction data. Anthropic emphasized that conversations within the personal finance section will not be used to train its AI models.

title_zh: 《崩坏：因缘精灵》定档明年春季，终测调整限定卡池
content_zh:
米哈游公布《崩坏：因缘精灵》的终测预告和实机演示，确认游戏将在 2027 年春季登陆 PC、iOS 和 Android。终测将于 11 月 25 日开始，目前已开放报名。

终测调整了限定角色和精灵卡池：玩家在相应限定卡池第一次抽到五星时，必定获得当期限定角色或精灵。获得当期限定角色后，还可免费领取与其配对的同行精灵。

这是一款以捕捉精灵为核心的开放世界角色扮演游戏。玩家可带精灵探索城镇和野外，也可搭配角色与精灵参加自动战斗。新演示展示了城市的昼夜变化和可进入的店铺。
title_en: Honkai: Fate Spirits Sets Spring 2027 Launch, Announces Final Beta Adjustments
content_en:
miHoYo has released a new gameplay trailer for its upcoming creature-catching open-world RPG, *Honkai: Fate Spirits*, confirming a Spring 2027 launch on PC, iOS, and Android. Registration is now open for the game's final beta test, scheduled to begin on November 25.

The final beta introduces major adjustments to the game's limited gacha banners. Players are guaranteed to receive the featured 5-star character or spirit on their first 5-star drop. Additionally, pulling a featured 5-star character automatically grants their paired companion spirit for free.

The latest showcase highlights core mechanics, including creature-assisted auto-battles, dynamic day-night cycles, and interactable shops scattered throughout its open world.

title_zh: CygamesEdge 首作《崩落之国》发售，从世界树往下跳
content_zh:
Cygames 旗下新品牌 CygamesEdge 的首款游戏《崩落之国》于 11 月 5 日发售，登陆 PS5、Switch 2 和 Steam。游戏由 CygamesEdge 与 ZEREO 共同开发，主角是一名从世界树枝干向下探索的少女。

游戏的主要挑战是判断落点。玩家要估算高度和风向，在会崩塌的枝干与平台之间跳跃，也可以捡起花苞扔向预定落点，让长出的花朵缓冲坠落。落地失误则可能要重新走一段路。
title_en: CygamesEdge Debuts Vertically Focused Platformer 'Falling Kingdom'
content_en:
Cygames' new label, CygamesEdge, has launched its debut title *Falling Kingdom* on PlayStation 5, Switch 2, and Steam. Co-developed with ZEREO, the action-platformer follows a young girl descending through the sprawling branches of the World Tree.

The game's central challenge focuses on precision landing and timing. Players must calculate drop height and wind conditions while navigating crumbling platforms. To survive steep drops, players can throw flower buds onto landing points to create safety cushions—though failing a landing can cost substantial progress.

title_zh: 谷歌视频模型 Omni 1.2 Flash 可生成 15 秒视频，支持对话改片
content_zh:
谷歌推出视频生成模型 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，单次生成时长从上一代最长 10 秒延长到 15 秒。用户可以接着在对话里修改同一段视频，例如替换商品、调光或切换横竖屏。

新版可以组合图片和短视频作为参考，Google Cloud 的音频参考功能只对获准使用的用户开放。谷歌的演示用多轮指令替换了同一片段的背景，保留了人物的表演与镜头构图。

模型已在 Gemini API 和 Google Cloud 正式开放。720p 视频每秒收费 0.07 美元，比上一代低 30%。在 Gemini 应用中，15 秒视频生成功能正向 Google AI Ultra 订阅者陆续开放。
title_en: Google Launches Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with 15-Second Video Generation and Conversational Editing
content_en:
Google has unveiled its latest video generation model, Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, expanding maximum clip duration from 10 to 15 seconds. A key addition is conversational video editing, allowing users to modify existing clips through follow-up prompts—such as replacing products, adjusting lighting, or changing aspect ratios—while preserving the original performance and shot composition.

The updated model accepts combined image and video reference inputs, with audio reference features available for approved enterprise users on Google Cloud.

Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is now available via the Gemini API and Google Cloud at $0.07 per second for 720p output—a 30% reduction in pricing compared to the previous model. The 15-second video feature is also rolling out to Google AI Ultra subscribers within the Gemini app.

title_zh: Instagram 剪辑工具 Edits 登陆 Mac，可免费导出无水印 4K 视频
content_zh:
Instagram 将旗下视频剪辑工具 Edits 带到 Mac。桌面版支持多轨时间线、转场关键帧和精细的音频波形，并提供色轮、曲线等调色工具。

用户可导入自己的字体和 LUT，也可以自定义键盘快捷键。应用支持多种横竖屏比例，可免费导出无水印 4K 视频。直接发到 Instagram 时，可以添加标签和地点，或先用试发 Reels 功能向非关注者展示。

手机端保存的音频和文字样式已可在 Mac 上使用，Instagram 正在开发同一剪辑项目在手机与电脑间接续编辑的功能。
title_en: Instagram Launches 'Edits' Video Editor on Mac with Free 4K Watermark-Free Exports
content_en:
Instagram has brought its standalone video editing application, Edits, to Mac. The desktop version introduces advanced editing capabilities, including multi-track timelines, transition keyframes, precise audio waveforms, and professional color grading tools such as color wheels and curves.

Users can import custom fonts and LUTs, configure personalized keyboard shortcuts, and work across various aspect ratios. The app supports free 4K video exports without watermarks. When publishing directly to Instagram, creators can attach tags, add locations, or test out content with non-followers using the trial Reels feature.

Additionally, saved audio and text styles from the mobile app now sync with Mac. Instagram is also developing cross-device project continuity, which will soon allow creators to seamlessly transition edits between mobile and desktop devices.

title_zh: 2027 年放假安排公布，春节从除夕连休 9 天
content_zh:
国务院办公厅公布 2027 年放假安排。春节从 2 月 5 日除夕放到 2 月 13 日正月初八，共 9 天。1 月 31 日和 2 月 14 日两个周日上班。

劳动节 5 月 1 日至 5 日放假，5 月 8 日上班。国庆节 10 月 1 日至 7 日放假，9 月 26 日和 10 月 9 日上班。元旦和清明节各连休 3 天，端午节和中秋节都落在周三，各放假 1 天。
title_en: China Unveils 2027 Holiday Schedule, Featuring a 9-Day Lunar New Year Break
content_en:
The General Office of the State Council has released China's official public holiday schedule for 2027. Highlighted by an extended break, the Lunar New Year holiday will span nine consecutive days, running from Chinese New Year's Eve on February 5 through February 13. Adjusted working Sundays will fall on January 31 and February 14.

Other major holiday arrangements include a five-day break for Labor Day (May 1–5) and a seven-day holiday for National Day (October 1–7). New Year's Day and Tomb Sweeping Day will each feature three-day long weekends, while the Dragon Boat Festival and Mid-Autumn Festival—both falling on Wednesdays—will be observed as single-day holidays.

title_zh: 综艺《后会友期》带火鸭舌，淘宝闪购外卖量周环比增逾五成
content_zh:
综艺《后会友期》播出后，嘉宾厉娜爱吃的鸭舌在外卖平台走红。第一财经从淘宝闪购获得的数据显示，10 月 30 日以来，平台鸭舌外卖量周环比增长超过 50%，午餐和下午茶时段的鸭舌订单分别增长 75% 和 71%。

分品牌看，绝味鸭脖在淘宝闪购的鸭舌订单周环比增长 200%，同比增长 280%。分城市看，长沙、武汉、重庆、深圳和北京的鸭舌订单增长最快。
title_en: Reality Show Spark Drives 50% Surge in Duck Tongue Takeout Orders on Taobao Flash Purchase
content_en:
Duck tongue orders have surged on food delivery platforms following the broadcast of the reality show *See You Again*, where celebrity guest Li Na highlighted her fondness for the delicacy. According to data from Taobao Flash Purchase, duck tongue delivery orders jumped over 50% week-on-week starting October 30, with lunch and afternoon tea orders increasing by 75% and 71%, respectively.

Popular snack brand Juewei saw its duck tongue orders on Taobao Flash Purchase surge by 200% week-on-week and 280% year-on-year. Cities leading the national spike in demand include Changsha, Wuhan, Chongqing, Shenzhen, and Beijing.

title_zh: 亚马逊接入 Uber Eats，美国 Prime 会员可在购物 App 点外卖
content_zh:
亚马逊宣布与 Uber Eats 合作，美国符合条件的 Prime 会员已可在 Amazon.com 和亚马逊购物 App 里订餐。通过亚马逊向参加活动的餐厅下单，满 25 美元可免配送费。

合作覆盖 Uber Eats 的连锁餐厅和当地商户。上线后的前 14 天，会员在亚马逊下的前两笔符合条件的订单，每笔可减 20 美元。原有的 Prime 与 Grubhub 合作将随新服务上线逐步结束。
title_en: Amazon Partners with Uber Eats to Integrate Food Delivery into Shopping App
content_en:
Amazon has officially partnered with Uber Eats, allowing eligible US Prime members to order food directly through Amazon.com and the Amazon shopping app. Prime members will receive free delivery on qualifying orders of $25 or more from participating local merchants and major chain restaurants.

To celebrate the rollout, Amazon is offering $20 off each of the first two qualifying orders placed within the first 14 days of launch. As part of this transition, Amazon's previous food delivery integration with Grubhub will be gradually phased out.

title_zh: 《嫁金钗》空镜现反向「AI 生成」字样，引发审片讨论
content_zh:
《嫁金钗》迎来大结局后，有观众发现剧中一段竹叶空镜的右上角留有反向的「AI 生成」字样。都市现场报道展示了这段画面的截图。

争议随后延伸到长剧的审片和标注。澎湃新闻首席评论员李勤余在署名文章中指出，剪辑、调色和审片都应有机会发现画面上的异常。如果剧方希望主动提示观众使用了 AI，也可以在更清楚的位置标注制作信息。
title_en: Accidental AI Watermark in Chinese Drama Sparks Debate Over Quality Control
content_en:
Following the finale of the Chinese drama series *Jia Jin Chai*, eagle-eyed viewers spotted a subtle post-production slip-up: a cutaway shot of bamboo leaves featured a reversed "AI Generated" watermark in the upper right corner.

The blunder quickly sparked widespread discussion surrounding production oversight and content review standards. Industry critics pointed out that post-production teams—including editors and colorists—should have caught the anomaly before broadcast. Media commentators added that if production teams wish to disclose the use of AI tools, they should do so clearly in the credits rather than leaving stray artifacts in the footage.

title_zh: 迈克·李新片《Tender Loving Care》发布预告，聚焦英国照护者
content_zh:
迈克·李编剧并执导的新片《Tender Loving Care》发布预告，北美发行方 Bleecker Street 计划于 12 月将影片带进影院。

影片以英国脱欧后的英格兰为背景，由凯特·奥弗林饰演一名社工。她既要应对工作中接连出现的照护难题，也要和家人一起面对父亲身体状况的变化。

本片今年获得圣塞巴斯蒂安国际电影节最佳影片金贝壳奖及评审团最佳编剧奖，奥弗林并列获得最佳主演银贝壳奖。
title_en: Mike Leigh’s Award-Winning Drama 'Tender Loving Care' Releases First Trailer
content_en:
Distributor Bleecker Street has unveiled the trailer for *Tender Loving Care*, the latest feature written and directed by veteran filmmaker Mike Leigh. The film is set to hit North American theaters this December.

Set in post-Brexit England, the story stars Kate O'Flynn as a dedicated social worker striving to manage an overwhelming series of professional caregiving demands alongside her own father's deteriorating health.

The film has already earned major critical acclaim, winning the prestigious Golden Shell for Best Film and Best Screenplay at this year's San Sebastián International Film Festival, with O'Flynn also taking home a Silver Shell for Best Leading Performance.

title_zh: 《复仇者联盟 5》公布全球宣传行程，上海列入九站名单
content_zh:
漫威公布《复仇者联盟 5》的全球宣传行程，上海与首尔、伦敦、罗马等城市一起列入九站名单。漫威也更新了官方倒计时直播，毁灭博士身后的画面会轮换显示各站城市的天际线。

这部电影由罗素兄弟执导，小罗伯特·唐尼饰演毁灭博士。迪士尼电影官网列出的北美院线上映日期为 12 月 18 日。
title_en: Marvel Unveils Global Press Tour for 'Avengers 5' Featuring Shanghai
content_en:
Marvel Studios has officially revealed the global press tour schedule for *Avengers 5*, selecting Shanghai alongside eight other major international destinations, including Seoul, London, and Rome.

To mark the announcement, Marvel updated its official livestream countdown, displaying Doctor Doom against a rotating backdrop of the featured cities' skylines.

Directed by the Russo Brothers, the highly anticipated film stars Robert Downey Jr. as the iconic villain Doctor Doom. According to Disney's official movie website, the blockbuster is scheduled for a North American theatrical release on December 18.
